mei.primaryReturn: I would come back another evening on the laptop, but only if something happens in the first hours that needs my decision. I would not leave it running.
mei.laterFullReturn: I would come back another evening on the laptop. I would do that only if the first hours held a decision that needs me. On the phone I did get one, at 4.8 m. So I might return on either device, but I cannot promise the laptop run would give me one. I did not test a second night.
rankedAsks: Give me a decision in the first hours. Or tell me at the start that nothing needs deciding until the level rises. The laptop gave me none in 3 real minutes.
Show what the gate did to the level, apart from the rain. After my two turns, the level fell from 4.8 to 3.5 m, but I could not tell how much was the gate.
Fix the clipped Dai strip on the phone, and shorten the opening text.

samir.primaryReturn: I might come back another evening, on desktop only, if I could answer Dai about Morgan and learn who the town people are, and if each step cost far less than half a minute of waiting. I would not leave it running.
samir.laterFullReturn: I might come back another evening, on desktop only. My conditions: I can answer Dai about Morgan or ask about the town people, and each step costs far less than half a minute of waiting. Without those I would not return. I would not leave it running, because it needs me at each step. I would not come back on the phone tonight. The layout is fixed, but I already know the loop from desktop.
rankedAsks: Let me answer Dai, or ask him about himself, Morgan and the town. He asked about Morgan again and there is still no reply control.
Show the level tile's last reading, with its age, instead of "— not read" all night while Dai reports 3.8 to 4.0.
Cut the waiting. Each step is about 30 real seconds with nothing for me to do.

leila.primaryReturn: Maybe: another evening, on desktop only, and only if each night asked me for more than about four choices. I would not leave it running.
leila.laterFullReturn: Maybe: another evening, and on desktop. I would only come back if a night asked me to decide more than about four things. I would not leave it running while I do something else.
rankedAsks: Give me more to decide each night.
Show a visible result when I act. "Doubt this reading" left no mark, and my desktop "1 turn" request never happened.
Stop the clock while I read an inspection panel.

rosa.primaryReturn: No, not on my own. I would close it and not leave it running. I might come back another evening only if the gate panel said the call-and-interrupt idea once, in plain words, and showed me one job to do with the gate.
rosa.laterFullReturn: No, not on my own. I would come back another evening only if the gate panel said the call idea once, in plain words, and showed me one job to do with the gate. I would not leave it running; I would close it. This time I would be more willing than last time, because the first screen no longer blocks me. I cannot say what happens after the gate, because I stopped there.
rankedAsks: Say "A call interrupts his current job, even if he does not agree. If he goes back to it afterwards, its report can come later." once, in plain words. It is now repeated in all six turns buttons.
Remove "How Dai expects to feel after this job" and "Hold a button to insist", or explain them in one plain sentence.
Do not hide the "What counts as caught?" rule only behind a folded heading without saying what "caught" means. I did not open it, so this is a guess from the heading.

ida.primaryReturn: Yes, I would come back another evening on the laptop to play Monday again, as long as Tuesday tells me what a high weir reading is. On the phone I would not come back.
ida.laterFullReturn: "Yes, I would come back another evening on the laptop to play Monday again, as long as Tuesday tells me what a high weir reading is. On the phone I would not come back." Monday gave me exactly what I like: a quiet log I read at my own pace, then a morning list I can check against. I would not leave it running in a tab. I would come back on another evening I set aside, on the laptop only. If Tuesday still leaves me guessing at the weir, I would play Monday once more and stop there.
rankedAsks: Show a scale or a warning mark for the weir and the bridge. Without one, 0.37 m or 0.46 m means nothing to me.
When I press "Doubt this reading", show at once that it was recorded, and remove the "How Dai expects to feel after this job" heading when every option under it just says "He agrees".
On the phone, make the inspection panel scroll and make the lightning drawing bigger, or leave the Tuesday gauges until I am on a bigger screen.
